notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
A patch has been released for Whirlwind Magician. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Made one of the strength fruits easier to obtain. (Hover over spoilers for details - these spoil how to get it as well as info about a [i]different[/i] secret item)
[spoiler]The strength fruit that requires using the Slingshot Jump ability to cross a large pit between Treetops East and Treetops West now only requires a single Slingshot Jump in order to reach.
[u]Developer Commentary[/u]: Previously this large pit could not be crossed with only a single Slingshot Jump - it required some additional movement to cross the full distance. I've noticed that members of the community believe it requires performing two Slingshot Jumps in a row in order to cross it, which is quite difficult to perform. However, this was not actually the intended method to cross the pit. The intended method was to perform a Slingshot Jump and then throw Gibson downwards multiple times in the air to stall your fall, since throwing Gibson downwards boosts yourself up slightly.
I have decided that this was too cryptic since the downward throw boost is never explicitly stated in-game and acquiring the Slingshot Jump powerup in the first place already requires some clever thinking. So now crossing the pit only requires a single Slingshot Jump. I believe this will result in a better experience because when players finally have that "a ha!" moment in figuring out how to get the Slingshot Jump powerup, they will then be able to use it to cross the pit and feel smart in finding the Slingshot Jump's application, rather than being immediately hit with another cryptic puzzle.[/spoiler]
[*]Added another playtester to the ending credits
[*]Removed an unnecessary [spoiler]Command Magic powerup[/spoiler] in Treetops East due to it misleading some players into thinking there might be a secret in that room (the room right after you get the ability to [spoiler]control Gibson[/spoiler]).
[*]Fixed the blurry rotated arrow sprite towards the end of the ruins.
[/list]

If you encounter any issues playing the game after downloading this update, please let me know in the discussion section below or email me at samuraimantis.help@gmail.com.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for waiting patiently for Whirlwind Magician. Unfortunately development has been coming along slower than expected due to life stuff. But still, significant progress on the final game has been made in the past few months and a few of the changes have been applied to the demo in the latest update which was released yesterday. Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Improved green and purple barrier pixie sprites
[*]Updated collectible fruit and ability item sprites to be more consistent with the rest of the game's art
[*]Breakable walls now have a particle effect when broken instead of just instantly vanishing
[/list]
Also if you're wondering "Where was patch 1.0.2?", that was some dialogue changes that were applied without an announcement.

As always, if you would like to leave feedback or report an issue found while playing, you can use the in-game feedback forms, leave a comment below, or email me at samuraimantis.help@gmail.com

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello! I've released a small update to the [i]Whirlwind Magician[/i] Demo: Save files will now track the amount of time you've spent playing, like how save files in most platformers do.
Some notes about the playtime stat:
[list]
[*]Playtime will not accumulate during cutscenes or while loading a level.
[*]Playtime WILL accumulate while looking at the map and while browsing the pause menu in-game. I thought it would be a good idea to do this since speedrunners tend to prefer including time spent browsing menus into their total time. In the full version of the game, time-attack mode—which is meant for speedrunning—will automatically skip cutscenes.
[*]Older save files from before this update will still work, but will start at 0 for their playtime.
[/list]

If you have any questions or feedback on how the playtime stat works, you can leave a comment below or email me at samuraimantis.help@gmail.com
